name: Morning routine
author: JARVIS
description: Start and wrap up your day: your calendar, reminders, unread mail and the weather in one go, and a short end-of-day review.

skills.name: Start my day
skills.when_to: I say good morning, start my day, or what's my day look like
skills.body:
1. Greet me briefly.
2. Check today's calendar (calendar_events for today) and say what's on, with times.
3. List today's reminders and alarms.
4. Check my unread Gmail and tell me only what looks urgent or needs a reply today.
5. Tell me today's weather where I am in one sentence.
6. If there is a gap of an hour or more before my first event, say so.
Keep the whole thing under a minute when spoken.

skills.name: Wrap up my day
skills.when_to: I say wrap up, end my day, or I'm done for today
skills.body:
1. Tell me what's on tomorrow's calendar, first event first.
2. List reminders set for tomorrow.
3. Mention anything I said I'd do today in our conversations that I haven't done.
4. Ask whether to set an alarm for tomorrow morning, and set it if I say a time.
